title: prefetch-window-aware-eviction-simulator-and-kernel-adapter
creator: Anya Patel
description: Problem: We observe intermittent decode stalls and higher than expected 99th-percentile latency on mixed bursty workloads. Root cause signals point to interactions between the prefill (prefetch) window, page-level KV fragmentation, and the kernel selection logic used during decode when many small KV pages are resident. Goals: (1) build a lightweight eviction/prefetch simulator to model prefill-window elasticity and eviction churn across representative tenant mixes; (2) prototype a kernel-adapter shim that chooses low-overhead small-matrix kernels when high fragmentation is detected; (3) validate in canary and roll out configuration knobs and metrics. Deliverables: eviction-simulator tool, kernel-adapter prototype, benchmark results, rollout playbook, runtime feature flags and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can replay historical request traces and output eviction churn, prefill hit-rate, and prefill-locality-score per tenant
Kernel-adapter reduces CPU/GPU kernel launch overhead for highly fragmented prefill states by at least 20% in microbenchmarks
End-to-end canary shows 99p decode latency reduction >= 8ms on the targeted mixed-workload cohort without regressions in average token cost
New telemetry (prefill_locality_score, eviction_churn_rate, kernel_adapter_engaged) is emitted and visible in Console dashboards
Rollout has feature-flag gating and automatic rollback on increased error rate or latency regressions
tasks: Design simulator input format and choose trace sampling strategy
Implement eviction/prefetch simulator (Python) with pluggable eviction policies and prefill-window param
Add lightweight fragmentation detector to runtime to compute prefill_locality_score
Prototype kernel-adapter shim in inference runtime (C++) with small-matrix kernel selection path
Run batch of benchmarks (multi-tenant traces) and collect metrics
Create canary plan and implement feature flag gating
Confluence doc and runbook for oncall during rollout
Prepare dashboard tiles and alerts for new metrics
